artworks.title: Civis Coloniensis Filia
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing in a slightly turned pose, facing the left. She has a calm expression with rounded cheeks and a straight nose. Her hair is covered by a coif or bonnet. She wears a long gown with a dark bodice and a lighter apron, a high-collar dress with puffed sleeves. She holds a piece of fabric in her left hand and her right hand is on her side. The woman wears simple footwear and no visible jewelry. The background is plain. The text "Civis Coloniensis Filia" is inscribed at the bottom, along with the artist's mark and date "W Kollars fecit 1643."

artworks.title: Mulier Coloniensis Exspatians
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing in profile, facing to the right. She holds a small object in her right hand. She has a prominent nose, delicately rounded chin, and a gentle smile. She wears an elaborate headdress covering her hair, a fitted bodice with a high ruff collar, long sleeves with visible stitching, and a long skirt with intricate texture. She wears ornate shoes and has a cylindrical object draped over her left arm, with a tassel or pom-pom at one end. The background is plain and unadorned.

artworks.title: Ancilla Coloniensis
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing upright. She is wearing a long dress with a fitted bodice and a pleated skirt, covered by a large cloak that drapes over her head and shoulders. Her facial features include a straight nose and downturned lips, and her hair is not visible beneath the hood of her cloak. She wears a ruffled collar peeking from under the cloak. In her right hand, she is holding a small basket with a patterned handle. The background is plain and devoid of any distinct features.

artworks.title: Mulier Moguntiana
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing upright in profile. She has a poised posture with her head turned slightly to the side. Her facial features include a defined nose and chin. Her hair is styled in an elaborate updo and she is wearing a structured outer garment with a stiff ruff around her neck. The upper part of her attire is dark and textured, while the lower part is a pleated skirt. Her hands are clasped in front of her. The background is plain and the image is in black and white. The text "Mulier Moguntiana" is at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Mercatoris Francofurtensis Vxor
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body drawing of a woman standing in profile. She is facing to the left. Her facial features and high, voluminous hairstyle with a large fur headpiece are detailed. The woman wears an elaborate gown with layers, an intricately designed bodice with ruffles, a high, lacy collar, and a long, full skirt covering her legs, with toes of shoes visible. Her right hand is outstretched, possibly holding a small book or fan. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Mercantoris Hanauiensis Vxor
artworks.description: This is a depiction of a woman standing upright. She is facing forward with her head slightly turned to her left. Her facial features show a calm expression. She has hair peeking out from beneath a lace-trimmed cap or bonnet. The woman wears a long, dark dress with a fitted bodice and lace-trimmed wide collar, along with a light-colored floor-length underskirt. A pouch or decorative tassel hangs from her side. She holds a small object in her right hand near her waist. The background is plain, and the text at the bottom reads "Mercatoris Hanauiensis Uxor."

artworks.title: Mulier ex inferiori Palainatu
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing upright. She has an oval-shaped face with a calm expression and is wearing a tall, rounded hat with textured surface. Her hair is neatly tucked beneath the hat. She is dressed in a long gown with a fitted bodice, large ruffled collar, and slim sleeves with ruffled cuffs. The skirt is long and layered. She holds a small pouch or purse in front of her. The background is plain and unadorned. The image is framed with a simple line, and below it is the text "Mulier ex inferiori Palatinatu," along with the artist's information and the date, 1643.

artworks.title: Matrona Argentinensis Caenam Dni Accedens e des Nymphs)
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body portrait of a person standing upright. The person is facing slightly to the side, with hands resting near the waist. Their facial features include a serious expression, with a high, stiff ruff surrounding the neck, giving prominence to their face. They are wearing a rounded hat that is fitted closely to the head, obscuring the hair. The clothing consists of a long, heavy gown with full sleeves and a wide, layered collar. There is no visible jewelry, and no objects are being held. The background is plain and unadorned. The bottom of the image includes a signature and inscription in Latin text.

artworks.title: Mulier Argentinensis
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing upright. She has a composed expression with a direct gaze. She wears a dress with intricate detailing, featuring a heavily gathered skirt, fitted bodice, and puffed sleeves. The woman's hair is styled under a structured headpiece. She stands with one hand over her abdomen and the other positioned near her chest. The background is plain with inscriptions in the upper and lower parts of the image.

artworks.title: Mulier Argentinensis
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in a full-length profile view, standing upright and facing to her right. She has a composed expression, delicate facial features, and a large, elaborate headpiece. She is wearing a dark form-fitting outfit with a striped underskirt, a fabric around her neck, and hands in a muff. Her shoes have pointed toes. The background is plain with a border at the bottom, and the text below labels the image as "Mulier Argentinensis."

artworks.title: Virgo Nuptialis Argentinensis
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing upright, facing forward. They have delicate facial features and are wearing an elaborate headpiece, a long-sleeved garment with a high neckline, and a wide ruffled collar. The person is holding two items in their hands and the background is plain. The text surrounding the image is in a classical font.

artworks.title: Virgo Argentinensis
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing. They are facing slightly to the right, with one hand on their hip and the other hanging down by their side. The person's facial features are delicately engraved with a serious expression. They wear a rounded hat that complements their short, neatly kept hair. The person is dressed in traditional attire featuring a long-sleeved blouse under a decorative vest, with a large, full-length skirt flaring out from the waist. They also wear a scarf or ruff, and their shoes are adorned with intricate patterns. There are no visible accessories or objects in their hands. The background of the image is plain with a subtly patterned floor. The text "W. Hollar delin" and "Virgo Argentine[n]sis" is inscribed at the bottom, identifying the artist and potentially the subject of the attire.

artworks.title: Virgo Argentinensis
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing in a frontal position with her body slightly turned to the left. She has short hair partially covered by a large, circular hat. She is wearing a long gown with a fitted bodice and full sleeves, layered with a dark, short-sleeved garment. Her hands are positioned in front of her body, playing with her attire. There are no visible pieces of jewelry on her. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Ancilla Argentinensis
artworks.description: The image shows a person in profile facing left, with their right hand extended palm-up and left arm relaxed. The person has delicate facial features, a small nose, and is wearing a cap or bonnet that covers their head. They wear a long dress with a fitted bodice, long sleeves, and a waist-down garment resembling an apron. Their attire includes patterned textures and possibly a shawl or scarf around the neck. The person's footwear is not clearly visible. The background is plain with no visible jewelry.

artworks.title: Matrona Bernensis
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in profile, wearing a tall hat and a long gown. Her hands are clasped in front of her body. The background is plain, and there is text above and below the figure identifying her as "Ein Burgerfraw zu Bern" and "Matrona-Bernensis."

artworks.title: Mulier Bernensis
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing. She has one hand on her abdomen and the other on her skirt. She is wearing a dark bodice and a long skirt with vertical stripes, along with a distinctive ruffled collar around her neck. Her hair is covered by a flat hat. The woman has a calm expression on her face. The background is plain and there is text on one side of the image.

artworks.title: Mulier Basiliensis
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright with one hand on their hip and the other on their dress. They are facing forward with an oval-shaped face and minimal facial features. Their hair is styled in a rounded shape. The person is wearing a long dress with full sleeves, a fitted bodice, and a voluminous skirt that reaches the feet. A darker garment is worn over the shoulders. There are no visible accessories or objects in the image, and the background is plain.

artworks.title: Mulier Basiliensis
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright, facing forward. The individual has a composed expression with delicate facial features, including almond-shaped eyes and a slightly turned-down mouth. Dark hair is hidden under a voluminous fur hat, and a high, pleated collar encircles their neck. The person is dressed in a period-style outfit, a long, dark gown with a fitted bodice featuring vertical lines and long sleeves. The skirt is full and pleated, extending to the ground. Their left hand is positioned at the waist, resting on the fabric's folds. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Virgo Basiliensis
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a woman wearing historical regional attire. She is standing in a relaxed position with one hand holding a piece of fabric. The woman has an oval-shaped face, small mouth, and wide eyes. She wears a tall, pointed hat, a long-sleeved dress with a voluminous skirt, a structured bodice with vertical stripes, and a dark, possibly fur-lined shawl. The background is minimal and neutral. The text on the drawing says "Ein Basler Jung frau" and "Virgo Basiliensis".

artworks.title: Matrona Tiguriensis
artworks.description: The image shows a woman dressed in traditional attire consisting of a long, dark gown with a light-colored garment underneath. She wears a large, elaborate ruff collar and a head covering that frames her face, leaving only her facial features exposed. The woman's hair is concealed under the covering. She has delicate facial features and carries a chain or string of pearls. The background is plain and includes text in an elegant script.

artworks.title: Virgo Nuptialis Tiguriensis
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing with her hands clasped in front of her. She has an upright posture and a serene expression on her face, with delicately arched eyebrows and a faint smile. She has neatly styled hair and wears an elaborate headdress adorned with floral or lace patterns. The woman is dressed in a richly textured gown with a high collar, intricate lace details on the sleeves, and layers of ruffled fabric around her neck, creating a prominent collar. The gown is long and two-toned, with a lighter panel in the center decorated with chains. She wears a long chain necklace over the gown. The background is plain, and there are inscriptions in Old German script at the top and bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Virgo Tiguriensis
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in a three-quarter stance, facing slightly left. She wears a wide-brimmed hat with fur, an elaborate dress with lace details and voluminous sleeves, a large collar, and holds a fabric item in one hand. There is a plain background.
